pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patch size is largest and most elongated on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more compressed geometric forms toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform along the neck but exhibits significant thinning between the smaller patches on the mid-to-lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, visible as a series of small, dark vertical pixel clusters against the blurred background.
